changes: New: CREATE BEAT GRID in the AED SLICE menu cuts a Flex or Static sample, or a finished recorder buffer, into equal beats from trim start, so you no longer record an exact number of bars.
Encoder A picks SAMPLE or PROJECT BPM, encoder B 1, 2, 4, 16, 32 or 64 beats a slice; up to 64 slices. YES opens the stock CREATE or REPLACE SLICES question. Works while the pattern plays.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB, which is in the beta. Card firmware cannot include it.
Known issues: not offered with Recorder Loop Fix 0.1.0, which can make recorder slice 1 miss (sambanks/octabam#908); the open window's drawing takes about 6 % of the CPU.
Not yet tested: the MKI, and slices kept through a save and a power cycle. Nothing is saved for you, and clicks at slice boundaries are not smoothed.
